ItemID: unavailable; Title: Don Henley Cass County; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy country direction fits my interests, but I would pass this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Enjoying Old Sock makes this relaxed, bluesy Clapton release my strongest choice today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Revelator; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its blues and soulful guitar sound appeals to my Hendrix interest, but I would save it for later.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: In My Soul; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Soulful blues feels close to what I want after Memphis and Old Sock, so I would try this too.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Lost on the River: The New Basement Tapes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The roots-oriented songwriting sounds appealing, though it is less immediately compelling than the blues choices.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Shadows in the Night; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for blues and roots rock today rather than a collection of traditional vocal standards.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Boys & Girls; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The soulful, bluesy sound interests me, but I would stick with my two stronger picks this visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Jt - Before This World; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its mellow songwriting could suit my interest in You Should Be So Lucky, but I am not choosing it today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Down Where the Spirit Meets the Bone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The earthy roots sound fits my recent listening, but I would return to it another time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: New; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar melodic rock appeals to me, though I am more interested in blues on this visit.
